timing.candidate_observer: Controller committed-output observations; n-1 / last-first per request, excluding RESET/DUMP.
timing.baseline_observer: Retained service full-response decode aggregate; individual completion timestamps absent. No first99 window inference.

reset_audit.scope: Native reset operations/cold host metadata and all-owner barrier; full cold allocation bytes were not individually read back.

provider_audit.scope: Native and controller raw actual-provider agreement; no independent long-cohort recursive prediction reference.

timing.window: first through last output, excludes RESET and DUMP

work.window: Target ROW/resolution position >= prompt length; provider seed >= prompt length. Excludes first output/JIT/prompt, includes wasted speculative work.
